newsitem.title: USA: Beverly buys 7 nursing centers for $33 million.
newsitem.headline: Beverly buys 7 nursing centers for $33 million.

text.p: Beverly Enterprises Inc. said Friday its Beverly Health and Rehabilitation Services unit will buy seven nursing centres in Washington State for $33 million cash.
Beverly said it is buying the centres, which have a total of 784 beds, from Quad C Health Care Centres of Tacoma, Wash.
It said it expects to close the deal before October.
Beverly, based in Fort Smith, Ark., operates 580 nursing homes.
Its stock rose 19 cents to $16.94 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
